NATIONAL FORESTRY ACT 1984

FEDERAL TERRITORY OF LABUAN (MODIFICATION OF NATIONAL
FORESTRY ACT 1984) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 1(4) of the
National Forestry Act 1984 [Act 313], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Territory of Labuan
(Modification of National Forestry Act 1984) Order 2017.

  (2) This Order comes into operation on 1 January 2018.   .

Modification of the Act to the Federal Territory of Labuan
2. The National Forestry Act 1984 [Act 313] is modified in the manner set out in the
Schedule.
